description.ja: （2024/12/20記載）諸般の都合により、商品の発売月を変更させていただきました。
description.en: (Posted on 2024/12/20) Due to various circumstances, we have changed the product release.

description.ja: 惑星探査を得意とするエグザマクス「ラウンドノヴァ」が登場！
description.en: Introducing the Examax "Round Nova", which specializes in planetary exploration!

description.ja: • 武器持ち手と開き手の特徴的な形状のハンドパーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with uniquely shaped hand parts for the weapon handle and open hand.

description.ja: • 足底にはスキー板状のパーツを取り付け可能。スキー板状のパーツは腕部にも装着可能。
description.en: • Ski-like parts can be attached to the soles of the feet. The ski-shaped parts can also be attached to the arms.

description.ja: • 胸部などに取り付け可能なバッグパーツが付属。
description.en: • Includes bag parts that can be attached to the chest etc.

description.ja: • 新デザインのロイロイが付属。ロイロイは腰部に取り付け可能。
description.en: • Newly designed Loi Loi is included. Loi Loi can be attached to the waist.

description.ja: • シリーズ機体と同様に各部がフレキシブルに可動。
description.en: • Like the series aircraft, each part is flexible and movable.
